statement: Foxconn's July 2026 consolidated revenue reached NT$946.51 billion, up 54.19% year-over-year and 15.18% month-over-month, the first month above NT$900 billion, driven by cloud and networking and computing products.
why: The largest AI-server builder posting record monthly revenue on server-related demand is a near-real-time confirmation that accelerator systems are still shipping in volume.

impact.mechanism: ODM monthly revenue tracks AI-server shipments about one step downstream of GPU sell-in, so record cloud and networking revenue implies accelerators are moving through the build chain rather than sitting in inventory.

evidence.excerpt: Hon Hai Precision Industry (Foxconn) posted consolidated revenue of NT$946.51 billion (approx. US$29.37 billion) for July 2026, up 15.18% from the previous month (June 2026) and up 54.19% year-over-year.
growth attributed to 'cloud and networking products' (includes AI servers) and 'computing products' segments, with strong demand for server-related products cited as the primary driver.

confidence.basis: Digitimes report with the article body paywalled; corroborating outlets are named inside this one document rather than fetched separately, so no multi-publisher credit and confidence stays at medium.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: value 37.89 -> 54.19 (tol 1%); sources: Digitimes
